text:
nora: quick follow-up from last night's pinning incident. need owners for slab defrag + session expiry fixes.
nora: created ledger row: https://redwood.internal/frag-ledger/rows/1769998888 — add ETA by EOD.
felix: i'll own slab defrag prototype (background compaction per-slab) and perf tests. ETA 9 days.
yuna: i'll take session expiry hardening (shorter idle TTL + restart on leak detection) and acceptance tests. ETA 4 days.
infra-bot: incident: memory-pin-wave detected on cluster canary-east at 2024-08-10T03:12:10Z -> 5 nodes -> INC-5420
eng-oncall: noted. pattern: pins correlate with long-lived websocket sessions + heavy small-key churn.
felix: small repro script i'll run to simulate pinning:
felix: ```
# simulate many long sessions holding small keys
for s in 0..2000:
  conn = open_session()
  for i in 0..100:
    put(conn, key=rand_small(), value=rand(256))
  hold(conn, randint(300,1200))
```
yuna: good. i'll add a TTL-based eviction in the canary router so sessions idle > 10m get soft-closed and trigger async compaction.
felix: defrag plan: run background slab sweep every 60s, target slabs with frag_ratio > 0.55, batch free pages to avoid CPU spike.
eng-oncall: caution: background compaction can affect tail latency. add a rate cap and tie to p95 CPU usage.
infra-bot: metric note: median time from first long-session to pin = 11.2 minutes across incidents; linked: https://monitoring.redwood/pins
nora: owners recap: felix=slab defrag prototype + perf, yuna=session expiry + router change, eng-oncall=monitoring & safety thresholds. i'll coordinate cross-team review and stakeholder notes.
yuna: will post PR + canary plan with timelines. canary target: 3 nodes for 48h.
felix: will push perf artifacts to frag-bucket and add flamegraphs. ETA for first run: 3 days.
eng-oncall: i'll add dashboard panels: slab_frag_ratio, pinned_session_count, p95 latency overlay. ETA 2 days.
nora: final ask: owners drop a one-line weekly status in the ledger row before Mon sync. closing thread once ledger updated. :white_check_mark:
filename_note: Pinning incident follow-up: slab defrag + session expiry owners
